summary: First run on verbatim clone of AVA Vôlei Analytics. Backend: existing pytest suite (6 files) run against public URL: 65 passed, 1 skipped. AI /api/ai/analyze answers in Portuguese via the Emergent key (~11s). Frontend: Home stats (4 partidas/9 atletas/19 marcações), nav to Galeria/Atletas/Relatórios/IA/Config all work with no JS page errors. Gallery shows 4 seeded videos. Analyze page loads the player, scoreboard (match-counters), fundamento marker bar, 6 timeline items and the rallies panel. Athletes page shows 6 cards and the dossier opens with Pasta/Evolução/Comparar tabs and Export PDF/CSV. Reports page renders a recharts donut, both PDF buttons and CSV. IA page returns a markdown answer. Add video via YouTube link works: you must pick a Categoria, then it redirects to /analisar/{id}. The test video was deleted afterwards.

minor.issue: Returns 502 when called concurrently (Emergent key 429 concurrent_request_limit, seen in logs during the parallel xdist pytest run). Environmental, not a code bug. Sequential calls work.

Stats still list 'TEST_Iter3 Scoring Match' in partidas even though only 4 videos exist. Actions left over from the old pytest runs in the seeded DB are counted. The /api/athletes list also has 3 TEST_ athletes (hidden in the UI because they are inactive), so the Home page says 9 atletas while the Athletes page shows 6 cards.

issues: Seed YouTube IDs l9I8m9OQKWo and QH2-TGUlwu4 are unavailable: grey placeholder thumbnails (404s in the console) and 'Video unavailable' in the player for 3 of the 4 seeded videos. This is the original seed data, so it is expected for a verbatim clone.
Date field uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn calendar. Same as the original code.

action_items: Optional: the 3 TEST_ athletes and the orphan TEST_Iter3 actions in the DB make Home show 9 atletas while the Athletes page shows 6. Clean them up only if the user wants it.
No functional fixes required. The app works as a verbatim clone.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1352 lines (>700). Left as-is per the 'no changes' request.
AI uses model string 'claude-sonnet-5-5'. It works through the Emergent proxy.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted the video 'TEST_UI YouTube Add'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Avoid running AI tests in parallel because of the Emergent concurrency limit. AddVideo requires input-categoria to be selected before submit-video works.
